topics.name: Agent Planning, Tool Use, and Workflow Execution
topics.summary: These papers give language-model agents structured tools, plans, or workflow memory so they can complete multi-step tasks and recover from execution failures.

topics.name: LLM Evaluation, Benchmarks, and Reliability
topics.summary: The work builds tests, simulators, or evaluation protocols that expose capability gaps, brittle reasoning, calibration failures, and reliability problems in language-model systems.

topics.name: Language-Model Safety, Alignment, and Security
topics.summary: These studies examine harmful behavior, refusal and jailbreak dynamics, policy compliance, privacy leakage, watermarking, or defenses for deployed language models and agents.

topics.name: LLM Memory, Context, and Retrieval
topics.summary: The papers improve what language models retain, retrieve, or selectively expose over long contexts, linking external evidence and memory to grounded generation.

topics.name: LLM Training, Adaptation, and Preference Optimization
topics.summary: These methods adapt pretrained language models with parameter-efficient updates, preference signals, synthetic data, or training objectives that target reasoning and controllability.

topics.name: Efficient LLM Inference and Model Compression
topics.summary: The collection targets the cost of language-model serving through quantization, pruning, routing, speculative decoding, cache management, and hardware-aware kernels.

topics.name: Multimodal Language and Vision-Language Reasoning
topics.summary: These systems align text with images, video, audio, or spatial evidence so multimodal models can answer questions, ground claims, and follow visual instructions.

topics.name: Image, Video, and 3D Generation
topics.summary: The papers control generative models for images, video, avatars, and 3D scenes using structured conditioning, temporal consistency, editing, or physically informed objectives.

topics.name: Computer Vision Detection and Segmentation
topics.summary: These methods improve visual recognition with stronger features, boundary awareness, open-vocabulary detection, tracking, and efficient models for real-world imagery.

topics.name: Medical Imaging and Clinical Prediction
topics.summary: The work applies machine learning to medical images, physiological signals, and clinical records while addressing modality gaps, robustness, fairness, and clinically faithful explanations.

topics.name: Robotic Manipulation and Tactile Skill Learning
topics.summary: These papers learn contact-rich manipulation, grasping, locomotion, and tactile representations from demonstrations or simulation while transferring skills to physical robots.

topics.name: Autonomous Driving and Mobile Navigation
topics.summary: The studies build perception, prediction, planning, and control for vehicles or mobile robots under partial observability, delayed actions, and changing road scenes.

topics.name: Reinforcement Learning and Sequential Decision Making
topics.summary: These methods shape exploration, credit assignment, policy optimization, and safe decision making in environments where actions alter future observations and rewards.

topics.name: Time-Series Forecasting and Dynamics
topics.summary: The collection models temporal signals with probabilistic forecasts, state-space or dynamical-system structure, and representations that remain useful under nonstationarity.

topics.name: Anomaly Detection and Distribution Shift
topics.summary: These studies detect unusual behavior or changing data distributions, emphasizing robust thresholds, open-world generalization, and evaluation without leakage.

topics.name: Graph Learning and Structured Reasoning
topics.summary: The papers use graph neural networks, message passing, topology, or structured representations to model relational data and reason over interacting entities.

topics.name: Federated, Privacy-Preserving, and Edge Learning
topics.summary: These methods distribute training or inference across heterogeneous devices while controlling communication, privacy, personalization, and resource constraints.

topics.name: Causal Inference and Counterfactual Analysis
topics.summary: The work identifies causal effects or directions from observational and experimental data, using structural models, transportability, counterfactuals, and sensitivity analysis.

topics.name: Uncertainty Quantification and Conformal Prediction
topics.summary: These papers provide calibrated confidence sets, risk bounds, or uncertainty estimates that make predictions safer under finite samples and shifted conditions.

topics.name: Optimization, Search, and Learning Theory
topics.summary: The collection develops optimization algorithms, generalization analyses, lower bounds, and search procedures for learning systems and combinatorial decisions.

topics.name: Information Retrieval, Recommendation, and Ranking
topics.summary: These systems retrieve, match, rank, and recommend items or documents by combining dense and sparse representations, user intent, and sequential feedback.

topics.name: Speech, Audio, and Music Modeling
topics.summary: The work models speech, sound, and music for recognition, synthesis, generation, and understanding, with attention to temporal structure and speaker or acoustic variation.

topics.name: Natural Language Processing and Multilinguality
topics.summary: These studies advance language understanding and generation across languages and linguistic phenomena, including translation, low-resource evaluation, and structured text tasks.

topics.name: Cybersecurity and Networked Systems
topics.summary: The papers analyze attacks, traffic, vulnerabilities, and defenses in networked or software systems, often pairing learned detectors with provenance-aware evaluation.

topics.name: Remote Sensing and Geospatial AI
topics.summary: These methods extract structure from satellite, aerial, and geospatial data, combining multimodal alignment, segmentation, change analysis, and domain-specific uncertainty.

topics.name: Materials, Chemistry, and Scientific Discovery
topics.summary: The collection uses machine learning or agents to search scientific design spaces, model materials and molecules, and connect structured domain knowledge to discovery workflows.

topics.name: Energy, Power, and Industrial Systems
topics.summary: These studies forecast, control, or secure physical infrastructure such as power grids, batteries, buildings, and industrial processes using data-driven models.

topics.name: Social, Behavioral, and Human-Centered AI
topics.summary: The work studies people’s behavior, preferences, communication, and interaction with AI, including persuasion, education, workplace use, and social simulation.

topics.name: Datasets, Data Curation, and Domain Benchmarks
topics.summary: These contributions release datasets, benchmarks, or data-generation pipelines that make specialized capabilities measurable and support reproducible comparisons.

topics.name: Quantum Machine Learning and Quantum Computing
topics.summary: The papers connect quantum circuits or quantum-inspired representations with learning, control, coding, optimization, and physical-system modeling.

topics.name: Fairness, Interpretability, and Explainable AI
topics.summary: These methods expose model behavior through attribution, concept representations, interpretable architectures, and audits of fairness or explanation quality.

topics.name: Statistical Modeling and Signal Processing
topics.summary: The collection develops statistical estimators, signal representations, and probabilistic models for structured data where assumptions and finite-sample behavior matter.
